rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something usual or established by common practice, especially before a noun.

example.english: The customary practice is to distribute the documents before the meeting.
example.traditional: 慣常嘅做法係開會前先派文件。
example.jyutping: gwaan3 soeng4 ge3 zou6 faat3 hai6 hoi1 wui2 cin4 sin1 paai3 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this when an action or arrangement follows an established custom, meaning “as is customary” or “as usual.”

example.english: It is customary for us to take a walk in the park after dinner.
example.traditional: 照例，食完飯我哋會去公園行一陣。
example.jyutping: ziu3 lai6 sik6 jyun4 faan6 ngo5 dei6 wui5 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 haang4 jat1 zan6
